police.name: Humboldt County Sheriff's Office
police.snippet: The City of Blue Lake contracts with the Humboldt County Sheriff Department for all Law Enforcement services.

court.court_name: Superior Court of California, County of Humboldt
court.serves_note: Serves all of Humboldt County including Blue Lake
court.snippet: The Superior Court of California, County of Humboldt is located in the City of Eureka and shares space with the County in the County Courthouse Building.
